decisions.name: Festival Stone of Leafdawning
decisions.reason: Real and photogenic: the Festival Stone inside a ring of eight Empyrean statues in a grove at the gazetteer spot. It gets one golden-hour crane through the only clear gap between the grove trees.

decisions.name: Chapel Blackspire
decisions.reason: The open-air church exists: 10 pews, an altar group and a 20 m black spire on a meadow. It gets one locked tilt up the spire.

decisions.name: Festival Stone of Morningthaw
decisions.reason: Real stone flanked by ancient columns and the Broken Seal on a plateau. The acpedia map point is 186 m off, so the gazetteer position was used (it matches acpedia's second coordinate). Rank 3.

decisions.name: Obsidian Span
decisions.reason: A spectacular 290 m Empyrean ruin bridging a 250 m-wide river, with water. It gets an establishing shot, a river skim and a backlit boom-rise, all kept west of the landblocks missing from the kit (0xB4xx).

decisions.name: Pet Shop
decisions.reason: A real Aluvian cottage with rabbit hutches on a terrace above the river. Small, so one rank-3 arc.

decisions.name: Sea Coast Rocks
decisions.reason: The Shallows Pillars exist exactly as acpedia describes: four stone pillars in the surf under a 150 m+ sea cliff. They get a parallax slide and a backlit vertigo dolly-zoom.

decisions.name: Paradox-touched Valley Tent
decisions.reason: A real tent with the Strathelar pennant on a ridge above the valley ruins. It gets one rank-3 dronie out over the drop, kept north-east of the missing landblocks.

decisions.name: Citadel Apex
decisions.reason: A 66 m green-glass broken tower on a peak, very photogenic. It gets a helix and an overhead pass-over.

decisions.name: Citadel Valley
decisions.reason: Surface valley with the crashed Gaerlan's Citadel (a 5x5 grid of halls and spires) and a row of five ziggurat portals. It gets a spiral descent and a backlit fly-by of the portals.

decisions.name: Colier
decisions.reason: The ruined mining town exists under giant trees, with the grave Monolith, burnt stumps and a Life Stone on the hill. It gets a handheld shot at the Monolith, a top-down of the canopy and a low-angle on the Life Stone.

decisions.name: The Deep (Vissidal)
decisions.reason: It is an object/quest page, but a visible landmark stands at the coordinates: a mossy round spire structure with portalspace-rift lights. One rank-3 pedestal shot.

decisions.name: Temple of N'cthail
decisions.reason: A spectacular cross-shaped temple rising from the sea, with a 51 m central tower and Statues of Transport. It gets a sea skim, a high orbit and a graphic top-down.

decisions.name: The Deep (Dark Isle)
decisions.reason: Object page, but the visible landmark is real: the same spire structure in the shallows on coral, ringed by hourglass sculptures, with the Trial of the Deep portal at its foot. It gets one low orbit over the water.

decisions.name: Vaeshok's Cave
decisions.reason: The cave is a dungeon, but its surface shrine is visible on the hilltop: the spire structure with the Black Spear Ice Totem and skeleton pedestals. Exterior only, one rank-3 worm's-eye.

decisions.name: Relic Town
decisions.reason: The terraced ash ruins with towers, colonnades and glowing lamps exist 250 m north of the acpedia map point, matching acpedia's text coordinate. It gets a harbour establishing shot and a high angle, both kept south of the missing landblocks.

decisions.name: Shimena Keep
decisions.reason: A castle islet reached by a pier bridge across the strait, with a tower and a 62 m Tall Tree. It gets a pan from the shore, a skim along the bridge and a helix.

decisions.name: Tenkarrdun
decisions.reason: A huge volcanic crater with glowing vents and heat/eruption emitters. It gets a spiral descent and a backlit low-angle on a vent, both on the north side because the south landblocks are missing.

decisions.name: Aurlanaa's Aerie
decisions.reason: The gromnatross nest on a z-300 pinnacle with the white Empyrean hall beside it. It gets an orbit over the drop and a vertigo shot.

decisions.name: Portal to Bur
decisions.reason: The portal sits on a snow summit between four towers, with glowing orbs on pedestals. It gets a helix above the tower roofs and a backlit low-angle.

decisions.name: Northwatch Castle
decisions.reason: A real walled castle with a spired keep and a crystal-array platform, ringed by forest. It gets a high establishing shot and a fly-by. All gazetteer teleports are interior, so the outdoor teleport is derived.

decisions.name: Aun Settlement
decisions.reason: A Menhir Ring with a torch, a longhouse, tents around a campfire and the Entrance to Portal Space swirl. It gets a top-down of the ring and an over-the-shoulder past a menhir onto the portal.
